shared_elements: relief carving on a flat rectangular panel
row of repeated geometric motifs (zigzag/triangle band)
central vertical element flanked by figures
framed edge or border along the top
justification: Both are low-relief rectangular panels organised into horizontal registers, with a band of repeated geometric triangular/zigzag ornament and figures arranged symmetrically around a vertical axis, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a coarse, sparse, weathered stone carving with a few large isolated animal forms and much blank ground, while B is a dense, tightly packed, curvilinear and highly ornamented composition with no empty space and a wholly different, fluid carving idiom.
